evidence.text: GENCI, a public operator in France, acquires national high-performance computing (HPC) resources, including supercomputers and storage facilities. These systems are hosted and operated by its associate centers: CINES (France Universités), IDRIS (CNRS), and TGCC (CEA). ([genci.fr](https://www.genci.fr/en/learn-about-genci/who-we-are?utm_source=openai))

blocks.text:
Proposed decision
Assess consortium ownership with separately agreed operations and maintenance responsibilities. Ownership does not establish an ability to operate the facility.
Rationale
Case assumptions: shared research and teaching workloads; operating capacity and member commitments remain unconfirmed.
Evidence

blocks.text:
Proposed decision
Commission a site-specific grid connection and impact study before choosing a connection arrangement.
Rationale
The 25 MW course reference is a case assumption. It does not establish local grid capacity or effects on other customers.
Evidence
RTE requires a Technical and Financial Proposal (PTF) to establish connection conditions, detailing the chosen solution, work scope, costs, and timelines. ([services-rte.com](https://www.services-rte.com/fr/decouvrez-nos-offres-de-service/raccorder-une-installation-au-RPT.html?utm_source=openai)) 
Unknowns
Connection date, upgrades, queues, cost allocation and curtailment remain unconfirmed.

citations.title: Signature of the Hosting Agreement for the Second European Exascale Supercomputer, Alice Recoque - The European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking (EuroHPC JU)

blocks.text:
Proposed decision
Stage funding decisions: demand and site screening first; construction only after a grid offer, permits, bids and member commitments; equipment delivery aligned with power readiness.
Rationale
These are proposed project gates, not lender requirements. An example elsewhere does not justify our investment.
Evidence
In June 2024, the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking signed a hosting agreement with GENCI for the Alice Recoque supercomputer, to be operated by CEA. ([eurohpc-ju.europa.eu](https://www.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/signature-hosting-agreement-second-european-exascale-supercomputer-alice-recoque-2024-06-21_en?utm_source=openai)) 
Unknowns
Funding terms and risk allocation remain open. Provisionally, the consortium bears delay and unused-capacity risk unless contracts transfer it.
